text:
Lena (People Ops): Quick reminder: annual attestation window opens today. Required: complete 7-min attestation and link/upload any missing SOC2/ISO artifacts by EOD next Thursday (6 business days). Form: https://redwood-internal.company/attest/annual-2026

Omar (Security): Note: new small policy update this cycle: add EvidenceVersion=v2 tag or update team_evidence.csv with source+retention info. If an asset contains real identifiers and is unencrypted, scrub and upload an encrypted copy.

Priya (Manager): For contractors, do we need signed DPAs too?

Lena (People Ops): Yes — contractors who touch customer data must have signed DPAs and an attestation. Managers: reply with `team: contractor1, contractor2` so we can cross-check.

Dan (Eng): Quick helper for git:```bash
echo "EvidenceVersion=v2" >> scrub_status.md
git add scrub_status.md && git commit -m "chore: evidence v2" && git push
```

Lena (People Ops): Office hours: Tue 10-11am PT & Thu 3-4pm PT in #compliance-help. If you cant make it, open a ticket at https://redwood-internal.company/it-requests with subject "attestation-help".

ComplianceBot: Reminder scheduled: 72h, 24h, and final-hour pings.

Priya (Manager): Thanks — posting our contractors now.

Lena (People Ops): Appreciate it; well follow up with any missing items. Final summary will be posted after the deadline.
